title: WebUniverse: Scaling Verified Training Data for Agentic Web Development
abstract: arXiv:2610.33149v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Training agents for front-end web development requires demonstrations of code editing, execution, browser inspection and revision, yet public trajectories and reusable task environments remain limited. We introduce WebUniverse, a pipeline that constructs verifiable tasks with verified development trajectories from open-source repositories and real web pages. The tasks cover text-grounded application development in standalone and iterative settings and vision-grounded reproduction across pages and viewports. We collect agent trajectories for these tasks and verify the resulting applications against task-specific functional or visual requirements. We release WebUniverse-Env, containing 15K executable task environments, and WebUniverse-Mix, containing the corresponding 15K development trajectories with verification records and scores. translated_title: WebUniverse：为智能体化Web开发扩展经过验证的训练数据
translated_abstract: 训练前端Web开发智能体需要代码编辑、执行、浏览器检查与修改等环节的演示数据，然而公开的轨迹数据和可复用的任务环境仍然稀缺。我们提出了WebUniverse，这是一个从开源代码仓库和真实网页出发，构建可验证任务及经过验证的开发轨迹的流程。这些任务涵盖了独立和迭代设置下基于文本的应用程序开发，以及跨页面和视口的基于视觉的网页复现。我们为这些任务收集了智能体轨迹，并针对任务特定的功能或视觉要求对生成的应用程序进行验证。我们发布了包含15K个可执行任务环境的WebUniverse-Env，以及包含对应的15K条开发轨迹（附带验证记录和评分）的WebUniverse-Mix。在WebUniverse-Mix上微调Qwen3.5-35B-A3B模型，将Vision2Web平均分数从51.7提升至68.3。
tldr: WebUniverse从开源仓库和真实网页构建了包含15K个可验证任务环境和开发轨迹的数据集，用于训练前端Web开发智能体，显著提升了模型在Vision2Web等基准上的表现。
en_tdlr: WebUniverse constructs 15K verifiable task environments with verified agent trajectories from open-source repositories and real web pages, substantially improving front-end web development agent performance on benchmarks like Vision2Web.
